facts.value: Surveys are used in psychology for the purpose of measuring attitudes and traits, monitoring changes in mood, and checking the validity of experimental manipulations.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Psychologists have commonly used paper-and-pencil surveys, but surveys can also be conducted by phone or via e-mail. Web-based surveys are increasingly used to reach a large number of subjects.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: In cross-sectional observational studies, psychologists collect data at a single point in time to assess the extent to which factors are correlated.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: In longitudinal studies, psychologists collect data on the same sample at two or more points in time, which may study trends across time.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: The purpose of longitudinal research can be to test causal hypotheses regarding conditions that commonly arise in people's lives that put them at risk for depression.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Selective attrition is a type of bias in which a particular type of research participant leaves a study disproportionately.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Arthur Bandura ran an observational study focused on children exposed to an adult exhibiting aggressive behavior and their reactions to toys.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: The result of Bandura's study showed that children who had seen the adult acting aggressively towards a toy were aggressive towards their own toy when put in a frustrating situation.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Exploratory data analysis includes a variety of practices that researchers use to reduce a large number of variables to a small number of overarching factors.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick

facts.value: Meta-analysis is a technique research psychologists use to integrate results from many studies of the same variables and arrive at a grand average of the findings.
facts.programme_association: Psychology and Sociology - BA | University of Limerick
